scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:hooks
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=bundle.js --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);'
scripts.build:hooks: esbuild src/hooklib.js --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=hooklib.js --banner:js='import { createRequire } from "module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);'
scripts.test: node test/skeleton.test.mjs && node test/batch-edit.test.mjs && node test/compress.test.mjs
scripts.test:boot: npm run build && node test/boot.test.mjs && node test/hooks.test.mjs
